name: JM Build Entry Gate v0.1
purpose: Require a prospective JM Build Route Manifest at the front door of high-confidence new or descendant executable bodies, without turning ordinary repairs, governance, recovery, registry maintenance, or documentation into paperwork rituals.

enforcement.meaning: PRs numbered 142 or lower are legacy-active work and are not retroactively blocked. PR 143+ receives hard enforcement when the classifier detects a high-confidence new executable body.

classifier.hard_trigger: At least one newly added production-signal file belongs to a path boundary that did not exist on the PR base. A new single-file HTML/JS/etc body directly under an executable root also qualifies.
classifier.repair_behavior: Adding or modifying files inside an already-existing body does not hard-trigger this v0.1 gate merely because code changed.
classifier.uncertain_behavior: No high-confidence trigger is not a claim that work is trivial; it only means this narrow automatic gate does not block it. Existing built-ins and proof gates still apply.

laws: Estate -> creation, not creation -> eventually remembers Estate.
New body creation is an exception after a real gap survives recovery.
Declare exact stack, donors, host/surfaces and true gaps before capability expansion.
Do not bypass built-ins to satisfy the entry gate.
Do not invent authority, donors, proof or gaps merely to make the manifest green.
Manual user action is escalation, not ritual.
